command:
set -euo pipefail; P=/home/andreas/frankenstein-repo/scripts/stern.py; TS=$(date +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S); cp -a "$P" "$P.backup-pre-browserless-guard-$TS"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/andreas/frankenstein-repo/scripts/stern.py')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('_CHATGPT_ERWARTETER_HOSTNAME_TEILSTRING = "ai-core-node"','_CHATGPT_ERWARTETER_HOSTNAME_TEILSTRING = "andreas-maco"')
needle='    env = _chatgpt_env_ohne_display(dict(os.environ))\n'
guard='''    # Andreas-MACO uses the persistent browserless ChatGPT context/reentry client.\n    # HARD RULE: this legacy web-automation lane must never auto-spawn a fresh\n    # browser/fingerprint or touch Cloudflare. The local Frank/GRID context lane\n    # is independent of browser authority. Fail closed here before invoking $B.\n    try:\n        _host = socket.gethostname().lower()\n    except Exception:\n        _host = ""\n    if "andreas-maco" in _host:\n        return {\n            "ok": False,\n            "grund": "BROWSER_AUTOMATION_DISABLED_ON_ANDREAS: browserless persistent ChatGPT context/reentry client is authoritative; no gstack/Cloudflare autospawn",\n            "external_challenge_policy": "FAIL_CLOSED_NO_RETRY",\n        }\n\n    env = _chatgpt_env_ohne_display(dict(os.environ))\n'''.replace('\\n','\n')
if 'BROWSER_AUTOMATION_DISABLED_ON_ANDREAS' not in s:
    if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('guard insertion point not found')
    s=s.replace(needle,guard,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$P"; python3 - <<'PY'
import stern,json
print('HOST_CONST',stern._CHATGPT_ERWARTETER_HOSTNAME_TEILSTRING)
r=stern._chatgpt_browse('status',timeout=1.0)
print('GUARD',json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True))
assert r.get('external_challenge_policy')=='FAIL_CLOSED_NO_RETRY'
PY
echo OLD_GSTACK_STATE_EXISTS=$([ -f /home/andreas/.gstack/browse.json ] && echo yes || echo no); echo HUMAN_BRAVE; pgrep -af '^/opt/brave.com/brave/brave --restore-last-session$|/usr/bin/brave-browser --restore-last-session' | head -10; echo WEB_AUTOSPAWN_HARDBLOCK=PASS
